title: God saw wickedness (Genesis 6:5) vs God saw 'very good' (Genesis 1:31)
summary: Two verses side by side that both use 'saw': Genesis 6:5, where the LORD saw that man's wickedness was great, and Genesis 1:31, where God saw all He had made and it was very good. 'saw' is large and green in both; 'very good' is blue with a small superscript 7.

text.text: 5 Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every intent of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
31 God saw all that He had made, and behold, it was very good⁷.

numbers.note: small superscript 7 after 'very good' in Genesis 1:31 (not explained on the slide)
